items.title: Which Voice Typing app is Worth your money?
items.summary: Today I am testing the most popular AI dictation apps side by side: Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, OpenWhispr, and the OpenWispr Android app from Team 3MB. These tools promise to turn your voice into clean, ready-to-send text in any app, but they work very differently. Some run in the cloud, others on locally on your device. Some clean up your speech automatically, others give you more functions like meetings, teams, notes and translation. In this video I compare accuracy, speed, privacy, pricing, and how well they actually convert what I say into usable text. items.title: Why Vibe Coders Still Need the Fundamentals
items.summary: In episode 1039 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Dr. John Renne about why coding fundamentals still matter in the vibe coding era. Dr. Renne explains that vibe coding makes it easy to get behind the wheel and drive, but knowing how to read Python, like knowing how the transmission and brakes work, is what lets him check that his models are doing what they should and gives him confidence in his work.

items.title: Hacking Didn't Change. Its Price Did
items.summary: In episode 1040 of the SuperDataScience podcast, @JonKrohnLearns discusses with Amy Blackshaw, SVP at Palo Alto Networks, how the economics of cyberattacks have drastically changed due to frontier AI. Amy explains that while the attacks themselves haven't evolved, the cost of entry for attackers has plummeted, making enumeration free. The expensive part of an attack used to be the expert thinking, and frontier AI has made that instant, tireless and cheap. As Amy puts it, the villain is still the attacker, who now has the same capabilities defenders do.
